prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Sign-in: Post-adoption timing, account recovery copy, and multi-device sync banners won; reordering sign-in elsewhere and adding sync or safety notices showed no clear effect.
Choose Path: Headline updates emphasizing clarity/value, spotlight layouts, visual stage redesigns, and outcome clarity tips won; checklist layouts, scroll redesigns, and reassurance notes hurt, while simplified copy showed no clear effect.
Home: Interactive waiting rooms, readiness/visibility status checks, and spawn location hints won; progress trackers, sound alerts, completion timers, and compatibility checks showed no clear effect.
Adoption: Photo quality guide previews and split preview layouts won; compact grids, guidelines banners, mascot stamps, fallback flows, spotlight selection views, and multi-step inspection flows hurt, while pre-adoption reviews and incentives showed no clear effect.
Finish: Interactive spawn placement flows, placement verification screens, and tray location tips won; direct controls guides, guided spawn stages, and first interaction tips hurt, while docking hints and welcome redesigns showed no clear effect.
Predictions: Underpredicted gains on counter-intuitive flow additions (such as placement verification screens and spawn placement flows) and overpredicted performance on severe flow failures (such as mascot stamp redesigns, direct controls guides, and guided spawn stages).

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Photo Upload Quality Inspection Stage: Adds a photo quality verification stage right after uploading custom pet photos to confirm facial framing and lighting before adoption. (why: Adoption step has the biggest drop-off (68.9% conversion) and support received multiple emails about failed custom pet generations.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Account Data Match Security Notice: Displays a clear sign-in reassurance hint explaining how signing in syncs existing pet profile data to prevent pet loss. (why: 8 support emails were received about pets missing or reset after signing in with a different account.)
2: [home, redesign] Desktop Background Readiness Stage Redesign: Redesigns the waiting screen into a split stage layout displaying desktop background render progress and ready status. (why: The home stage takes a long time (mean 2336s), causing users to close or abandon the app during rendering.)
3: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Tray Control Placement Verification Screen: Adds a dedicated desktop control check screen after onboarding welcome explaining system tray controls and desktop mascot visibility. (why: Multiple support tickets mentioned confusion over how to talk to, hide, or control the pet after finishing onboarding.)
4: [choose_path, redesign] Story Value Experience Split Redesign: Redesigns the intro story screen into a split view layout showing interactive pet desktop features alongside value narrative. (why: Choose path has high mean completion times (514s), requiring stronger visual clarity early in the flow.)
5: [sign_in, copy] Existing Account Pet Loss Prevention Copy: Updates sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly instruct returning users to sign in with their original account to preserve pets. (why: The top support theme (8 emails) was users losing pets due to logging in with wrong accounts.)
6: [adoption, copy] Custom Photo Quality Guidance Headline Refresh: Updates photo upload screen headline and body text with explicit photo lighting and framing requirements. (why: Adoption stage experiences the highest drop-off rate (68.9% conversion) and custom pet creation bug reports.)
7: [home, wait_info] Background Hatching Time Estimate Indicator: Enables duration time estimates and progress indicators on the home waiting screen. (why: The waiting step has a high mean time of 2336 seconds, leaving users uncertain about background activity.)
8: [finish, notification] System Tray Desktop Companion Control Tip: Adds a persistent system tray control shortcut tip on the finish welcome screen. (why: Users wrote support mails confused about how to hide, show, or control their desktop pet after setup.)

scores.note: Multi-step inspection flows hurt adoption conversion despite high drop-off.
Safety and sync notices show minimal performance gains on sign-in.
Readiness status checks and waiting screen redesigns consistently win.
Placement verification screens are proven counter-intuitive winners.
Visual stage redesigns and split layouts increase early path clarity.
Account recovery copy updates consistently improve sign-in retention.
Photo quality guidance headlines win without adding flow friction.
Progress indicators on home show modest positive gains.
Notification control tips at finish step historically reduce completion.
